column1: # Old Wix URL -> page on https://codeboxx.ai (SITE in redirects.js): the source of truth for the
# After an edit, run `node ops/nginx/redirects.js` to regenerate conf.d/codeboxx-redirects.conf
# (the tests fail until you do). Format and install: ops/nginx/README.md.
#   old path: /path (with or without a trailing slash), /path/* (the path and everything under
#             it, tried in file order after the exact paths) or * (the rest of the group's paths).
#   target:   a path on https://codeboxx.ai with an optional #fragment, = for the same path, or
#             - for none: the page is gone, the old URL answers 404 (exact old paths only).
# The request's query string (gclid, utm_*) is kept, before the fragment. Old paths match
# codeboxx.ai is the one live origin: www and the apex (codeboxx.com) send every path there, the
# old Wix paths to their page and everything else to the same path.
# www.codeboxx.com; codeboxx.com/<old path> used to work too (Wix redirected the apex to www).
# On the new blog since the list below was made (the AI Salon post under its Wix copy's slug, -1).
# Obsolete, left off the new blog on purpose (CLP-1378, Oct 2026): gone, so the old URL answers
# 404 and search engines drop it, instead of landing on the blog page.
# /technology-training-for-businesses are the Wix site's own shortcuts. /academy is
# the one Academy page: the homepage and every Academy page land on it (or its
# section); blog posts, Pinellas and contact keep their own page.
# academie gets the French twin of each target (/fr/academie, /fr/formation-entreprise).
# academie.codeboxx.com (Wix sent it to academy): the academy list, in French.
# The site icon browsers still ask the old hosts for (www keeps the path already).
